protocol: Official April 8-21 train and April 22-28 validation split; no random-log or hidden-test outcomes; published CWM likelihood and xDeepFM interaction structure adapted from the bundled KuaiRand reference; four user-ID-modulo folds for residual selection.

experiments.name: Counterfactual Watch Model likelihood
experiments.architecture: Full-metadata DeepFM trained with the reference CWM right-censored likelihood using cost inverse 40 and sigma 2; exact objective and a 0.1 CWM / 0.9 weighted-BCE anchor were tested.
experiments.evidence: Pure CWM reached 0.56198001 standalone and selected zero residual weight in all folds. The BCE-anchored model reached 0.60583085 standalone and 0.61280859 fixed, but held-out folds 1 and 2 regressed. Converting latent relevance to known-duration threshold-exceedance scores raised pure CWM only to 0.56788582; its residual weight remained zero. The best anchored threshold score reached 0.58638322 standalone and regressed to 0.61279964 fixed.

experiments.name: xDeepFM compressed interaction network
experiments.architecture: DeepFM plus two width-32 compressed interaction layers over ten rich categorical fields, full metadata, and watch-ratio auxiliary weight 0.4.
experiments.evidence: Epoch 2 reached 0.60725051 standalone (0.67527020 GAUC, 0.53923082 nDCG@5). Later epochs overfit sharply, falling to 0.57981420 by epoch 5. All four residual folds selected exactly zero weight, leaving the champion unchanged.

successful_tracked_run_totals.note: The lightweight duration-threshold score builder and standalone evaluator did not emit tracker records and are excluded. One mistyped xDeepFM audit path initialized verification but failed before finalizing its tracker; the corrected successful audit is included.

conclusion: Neither the reference counterfactual watch likelihood nor explicit compressed feature interactions added stable ranking information beyond the existing calibrated ensemble. The 0.6128046513 champion remains authoritative.
